# Founder Led Content

`founder-led-content` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/founder-led-content/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is this founder ready to start posting, and does each draft stay inside themes only they can own?

**Inputs:** Who the founder helps and with what problem, what they have seen across customer calls, what they believe their category gets wrong, what they have done first-hand, existing written material, and the realistic worst-week posting cadence

**Output:** A setup score with the failed checks named, three themes that survive the competitor test, a post bank drafted from existing material, per-post checks, and the three numbers to judge the channel on

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill founder-led-content`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/founder-led-content/resources/founder-channel.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/founder-led-content/resources/founder-channel.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Give {check, input}; with no input you get a labelled demo. An unknown check or top-level field stops the run, but fields inside input that it doesn't know are ignored, so use the names in the header.
- It is a rubric, not a prediction. It can't know whether a post will travel or bring buyers; judge the channel at ninety days on conversations, not impressions.
- Most checks take your answers on trust: whether a competitor could post a theme, whether the first line carries the point, whether proof is invented or permission is written.
- The post check spots engagement bait from a short phrase list and flags only the figures you list. It can't tell whether a draft sounds like the founder.

**Review before acting:** The founder approves the three themes and every draft, and checks each figure has its source in the post. Any customer result needs written permission, confirmed by whoever owns that customer relationship, before it is posted.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/founder-led-content](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/founder-led-content)
